items.title: Hatha Yoga
items.description: A calm practice with a clear structure: you learn the basic poses and connect them with your breath.

items.title: Gentle Morning
items.description: A gentle start to the day with light movement, stretching and a short breathing exercise.

items.title: Yoga Basics
items.description: The fundamentals explained step by step – no prior knowledge needed and plenty of variations.

items.title: Vinyasa Flow
items.description: Flowing sequences in the rhythm of the breath that combine strength and flexibility.

items.title: Ashtanga
items.description: The fixed series for experienced practitioners: powerful, focused and early in the morning.

items.title: Power Flow
items.description: A dynamic class for strength and stamina that challenges you and leaves you clear-headed.

items.title: Yin Yoga
items.description: Long-held poses for deep stretching and relaxation, especially in the evening.

items.title: Back & Breath
items.description: Targeted exercises for back, neck and shoulders – ideal for your lunch break.

items.title: Restorative
items.description: Supported poses with blankets and bolsters in which the body is allowed to recover.
